research_phase: BASE Fellowship Final Experiment — Corpus Expansion
experiment_name: NewsAssist AI BASE-50 Benchmark Experiment — MANIFEST-002 Expansion
research_objective: Extend the BASE50 benchmark evaluation to 24 new investigative journalism articles (12 Nigerian ICIR + 12 U.S. ProPublica/MLK50) added in BASE50-MANIFEST-002, using the identical experimental design as BASE50-EXP-001 to enable direct cross-corpus comparison.
research_question: How do different prompting strategies influence Information Integrity and Cultural Fidelity during AI-assisted transformation of high-context investigative journalism?
hypothesis: Prompt strategies emphasising brevity, engagement, or international adaptation will preserve core facts while increasing contextual loss, attribution loss, framing shifts, and cultural simplification relative to the faithful transformation baseline — consistent with BASE50-EXP-001 findings.
experiment_rationale: Holds all variables constant as in EXP-001 (single model, temperature 0.2, four prompt variants) while running the 24 expansion articles. Results are directly combinable with EXP-001 to produce a full 50-article BASE50 analysis. A multi-model comparison across the full 50-item corpus is planned for BASE50-EXP-003.

study_scope.model_version_note: Record exact provider-reported version string in every run.

generation_settings.note: All generation parameters must remain fixed across all 96 runs and must match EXP-001 settings for cross-experiment comparability.
